info.title: Beeching
info.description: A .NET CLI tool to delete multiple Azure resources in a single sweep of the Beeching Axe.

commands.name: axe
commands.description: The mighty axe that culls the resources

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --subscription
options.description:
The subscription id to use. If not
specified, the active Azure CLI
subscription will be used

options.name: --name
options.description:
The name (or partial name) of the
resources to axe. Multiple values can be
specified separated by :

options.name: --tag
options.description:
The tag key and value of the resources
to axe. Values are case sensitive and
must be supplied as a single string in
the format key:value

options.name: --resource-types
options.description:
Restrict the types of the resources to
axe. Multiple values can be specified
separated by :

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
The name of resources to exclude from
the axe. Multiple values can be

options.name: --resource-groups
options.description:
Axe resource groups and contents rather
than individual resource types

options.name: --force
options.description:
Force the axe to delete the resources if
locked

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt

options.name: --what-if
options.description:
Show which resources would face the axe
without actually culling anything

options.name: --max-retry
options.description:
6          Sets the maximum amount to retry
attempts when axe fails

options.name: --retry-pause
options.description:
10         Sets the pause in seconds for the retry
attempts

options.name: --debug
options.description:
Increase logging verbosity to show all
debug logs

options.name: --version
options.description: Reports the application version

options.name: --ignore-update
options.description: Do not check for update on startup
